subtitle: Lesson 29 · Update Sets & Change Management (Admin View)

code:
Instances & Environments (course 2) said:
  promotion is "deliberate and tracked,
   never a silent copy" -- mechanism TBD

This lesson: that mechanism is the Update Set
  sys_update_set  -> the container record
  sys_update_xml  -> each captured change inside it
caption: An Update Set collects changes so they move between instances as one unit.

eyebrow: The boundary that trips up new admins
code:
Captured by an Update Set:          NEVER captured:
- new Business Rule                  - a new Incident
- edited ACL                         - a new sys_user record
- new dictionary field               - a Change Request state update
- changed form layout                - any other DATA record

"How the system behaves"            "the data inside it"
caption: Update Sets move behavior, never the records that behavior acts on.

code:
If Update Sets captured data too:
  promoting a Business Rule to Production
  could drag along every test Incident
  created in Dev while building it

Scoped to config only -> promotion changes
  BEHAVIOR, never floods target with Dev's
  throwaway data
caption: Not an accident -- this is what keeps promotion safe.
